Figure 4C: linear mixed-effects model (LME) of protein biomarkers and treatment
effect on total cavity volume (CAVTOT, mL).

Figure 4D: linear mixed-effects model (LME) of protein biomarkers and treatment
effect on total lesion glycolysis (TLG, mL).

For each cytokine and outcome a model of the form
`outcome ~ Visit * Cytokine + Age + Sex + Arm + (1|ID1)` is fitted. Age is
included as a continuous covariate. Sex (Female, Male) and Arm (A, B, C)
are included as categorical covariates. The interaction term tests whether the
association between cytokine and lung lesions (outcome) differs between W0 and W16 after
adjusting for these covariates. P-values are FDR-corrected across cytokines
within each outcome.

# Load packages

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(readxl)
library(DataExplorer)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)
library(car)
library(emmeans)
library(writexl)
```

# Define file paths

```{r}
input_file  <- "Input/Cytokines_cleaned_log10_Predict-TB.xlsx"
input_pet   <- "Input/PET.CT_long_SATVI.xlsx"
output_main <- "Output/04. Figure_4C_4D"

dir.create(output_main, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Load data

```{r}
all_data <- read_excel(input_file, sheet = 1)

head(all_data)
dim(all_data)

pet_data <- read_excel(input_pet, sheet = 1) %>%
  select(ID1, Visit, CAVTOT, TLG) %>%
  mutate(Visit = paste0("W", Visit))

head(pet_data)
dim(pet_data)
```

# Filter and recode

Only the Null (unstimulated) condition is used. Visit W24 is excluded because
imaging data are only available at W0 and W16.

```{r}
cytokine_data <- all_data %>%
  filter(Comments == "success") %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = ifelse(Condition == "TB", "Mtb_Ag", Condition),
    Visit     = paste0("W", Visit)
  ) %>%
  filter(Visit %in% c("W0", "W16"))

cytokine_data <- cytokine_data %>%
  mutate(
    Age = as.numeric(Age),
    Sex = factor(Sex, levels = c("Female", "Male")),
    Arm = factor(Arm, levels = c("A", "B", "C"))
  )

cat(sprintf("Rows: %d | Visits: %s\n",
            nrow(cytokine_data),
            paste(sort(unique(cytokine_data$Visit)), collapse = ", ")))
```
# Merge cytokine and PET/CT data

```{r}
cytokine_pet_data <- cytokine_data %>%
  left_join(pet_data, by = c("ID1", "Visit"))
```

# Log transform imaging variables

CAVTOT and TLG are log10(1 + x) transformed to handle zero values safely.

```{r}
cytokine_pet_data_log <- cytokine_pet_data %>%
  mutate(
    CAVTOT = log10(1 + CAVTOT),
    TLG    = log10(1 + TLG)
  )
```

# Define cytokine columns

```{r}
meta_cols <- c("ID1", "Visit", "Condition", "Comments",
               "CAVTOT", "TLG", "Age", "Sex", "Arm")

cytokine_cols <- c(
  "BDNF", "CCL11", "Factor_VII", "ICAM_1",
  "IL_1_alpha", "IL_1_beta", "IL_10", "IL_12p40",
  "IL_12p70", "IL_18", "IL_1RA", "IL_3", "IL_4",
  "IL_6", "IL_7", "IL_8", "CCL2", "CCL3",
  "MMP_3", "TNF", "VEGF", "IFNG", "IL_2",
  "pan_IFNA", "IFNB"
)

cat(sprintf("Cytokines retained: %d\n", length(cytokine_cols)))
```

# Reshape to long format

Each row represents one cytokine measurement for one patient at one visit.

```{r}
data_long <- cytokine_pet_data_log %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = all_of(cytokine_cols),
    names_to  = "Cytokine",
    values_to = "Cytokine_Value"
  )

cat(sprintf(
  "Rows: %d | Cytokines: %d | Patients: %d\n",
  nrow(data_long),
  n_distinct(data_long$Cytokine),
  n_distinct(data_long$ID1)
))
```

)

visit_colors <- c("W0" = "magenta", "W16" = "#00CCFF")

# LME screening function
`screen_lme`: fits `outcome ~ Visit * Cytokine_Value + Age + Sex + Arm + (1|ID1)`
for one cytokine and one outcome. Covariates are passed as a character vector
and added to the formula dynamically. Returns Wald chi-square p-values for the
Visit main effect, cytokine main effect, and interaction. Returns NULL if data
are insufficient.

```{r}
screen_lme <- function(data, cytokine_name, outcome,
                       stimulation  = NULL,
                       covariates   = NULL,
                       min_obs      = 10,
                       min_subjects = 5) {

  dat <- data %>%
    filter(
      Cytokine == cytokine_name,
      !is.na(.data[[outcome]]),
      !is.na(Cytokine_Value)
    )

  if (!is.null(stimulation)) {
    dat <- dat %>% filter(Condition == stimulation)
  }

  dat <- dat %>%
    mutate(
      ID1   = as.factor(ID1),
      Visit = factor(Visit, levels = c("W0", "W16"))
    )

  if (nrow(dat) < min_obs || n_distinct(dat$ID1) < min_subjects) return(NULL)

  covariate_terms <- if (!is.null(covariates)) paste(covariates, collapse = " + ") else NULL
  formula_str     <- paste(
    outcome, "~ Visit * Cytokine_Value",
    if (!is.null(covariate_terms)) paste("+", covariate_terms),
    "+ (1|ID1)"
  )

  tryCatch({
    model     <- lmer(as.formula(formula_str), data = dat, REML = FALSE)
    anova_res <- Anova(model, type = 3)

    data.frame(
      Cytokine      = cytokine_name,
      Stimulation   = if (!is.null(stimulation)) stimulation else "All",
      Visit_p       = anova_res["Visit",                "Pr(>Chisq)"],
      Cytokine_p    = anova_res["Cytokine_Value",       "Pr(>Chisq)"],
      Interaction_p = anova_res["Visit:Cytokine_Value", "Pr(>Chisq)"],
      N_obs         = nrow(dat),
      N_subjects    = n_distinct(dat$ID1),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("LME failed for ", cytokine_name, " | ", stimulation, ": ", e$message)
    NULL
  })
}
```

# P-value formatting helper

```{r}
format_p <- function(p) {
  stars <- if (p < 0.001) "***" else if (p < 0.01) "**" else if (p < 0.05) "*" else ""
  label <- if (p < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else sprintf("p = %.3f", p)
  paste0(label, stars)
}
```

# LME plot function
 `plot_lme`: fits the same model as `screen_lme` and generates a scatter plot with LME-predicted regression lines per visit and 95% confidence bands from emmeans, adjusted to the mean values of Age, Sex, and Arm. Raw p-values with significance stars are shown in the subtitle. Regression equations for W0 and W16 are annotated in the top right corner of the plot.

```{r}
plot_lme <- function(data, cytokine_name, outcome, outcome_label,
                     visit_colors, stimulation = NULL,
                     covariates = NULL, save_path = NULL) {

  dat <- data %>%
    filter(
      Cytokine == cytokine_name,
      !is.na(.data[[outcome]]),
      !is.na(Cytokine_Value)
    )

  if (!is.null(stimulation)) {
    dat <- dat %>% filter(Condition == stimulation)
  }

  dat <- dat %>%
    mutate(
      ID1   = as.factor(ID1),
      Visit = factor(Visit, levels = c("W0", "W16"))
    )

  if (nrow(dat) < 10 || n_distinct(dat$ID1) < 5) return(invisible(NULL))

  covariate_terms <- if (!is.null(covariates)) paste(covariates, collapse = " + ") else NULL
  formula_str     <- paste(
    outcome, "~ Visit * Cytokine_Value",
    if (!is.null(covariate_terms)) paste("+", covariate_terms),
    "+ (1|ID1)"
  )

  model <- tryCatch(
    lmer(as.formula(formula_str), data = dat, REML = FALSE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(model)) return(invisible(NULL))

  anova_res     <- Anova(model, type = 3)
  visit_p       <- anova_res["Visit",                "Pr(>Chisq)"]
  cytokine_p    <- anova_res["Cytokine_Value",       "Pr(>Chisq)"]
  interaction_p <- anova_res["Visit:Cytokine_Value", "Pr(>Chisq)"]

  cyt_seq <- seq(
    min(dat$Cytokine_Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(dat$Cytokine_Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 50
  )

  pred <- as.data.frame(
    emmeans(model, ~ Visit * Cytokine_Value,
            at = list(Cytokine_Value = cyt_seq))
  )

  coefs         <- fixef(model)
  intercept_w0  <- coefs["(Intercept)"]
  slope_w0      <- coefs["Cytokine_Value"]
  intercept_w16 <- intercept_w0 +
    ifelse("VisitW16" %in% names(coefs), coefs["VisitW16"], 0)
  slope_w16 <- slope_w0 +
    ifelse("VisitW16:Cytokine_Value" %in% names(coefs),
           coefs["VisitW16:Cytokine_Value"], 0)

  eq_label <- paste0(
    sprintf("W0:  y = %.3fx %s %.3f",
            slope_w0,  ifelse(intercept_w0  >= 0, "+", "-"), abs(intercept_w0)),
    "\n",
    sprintf("W16: y = %.3fx %s %.3f",
            slope_w16, ifelse(intercept_w16 >= 0, "+", "-"), abs(intercept_w16))
  )

  stim_label <- if (!is.null(stimulation)) stimulation else "All conditions"

  x_unit <- if (cytokine_name == "pan_IFNA") "log10 fg/mL" else "log10 pg/mL"

p <- ggplot() +
    geom_ribbon(
      data = pred,
      aes(x = Cytokine_Value, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL, fill = Visit),
      alpha = 0.2
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = pred,
      aes(x = Cytokine_Value, y = emmean, color = Visit),
      linewidth = 1.5
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = dat,
      aes(x = Cytokine_Value, y = .data[[outcome]], color = Visit),
      alpha = 0.6, size = 2.5
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = Inf, y = Inf, label = eq_label,
      hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.5, size = 3.2,
      fontface = "italic", color = "gray30"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = visit_colors, name = "Visit") +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = visit_colors, name = "Visit") +
    labs(
      title    = paste0(cytokine_name, "  (", stim_label, ")"),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Visit: ",       format_p(visit_p),       "  |  ",
        "Cytokine: ",    format_p(cytokine_p),    "  |  ",
        "Interaction: ", format_p(interaction_p)
      ),
      x       = paste0(cytokine_name, " (", x_unit, ")"),
      y       = outcome_label,
      caption = paste0(
        "LME: outcome ~ Visit * Cytokine",
        if (!is.null(covariates)) paste0(" + ", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")),
        " + (1|ID1)"
      )
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray40"),
      panel.border    = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA)
    )

  print(p)

  if (!is.null(save_path)) {
    ggsave(
      file.path(
        save_path,
        paste0(cytokine_name, "_", stim_label, "_LME_", outcome, ".pdf")
      ),
      plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, units = "in"
    )
  }

  invisible(p)
}
```

# Run all analyses

For each outcome, all cytokines are screened. FDR correction is applied across
cytokines. Cytokines with a significant FDR-corrected interaction (p < 0.05)
are plotted. If no cytokines reach FDR significance, the top 10 by raw
interaction p-value are plotted instead.

```{r}
all_analyses <- list()
stimulations <- c("Null", "Mtb_Ag", "LPS", "IL1B")
covariates   <- c("Age", "Sex", "Arm")

for (analysis_name in names(analysis_config)) {
  config <- analysis_config[[analysis_name]]

  for (stim in stimulations) {
    out_dir <- file.path(output_main, analysis_name, stim)
    dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

    cat(sprintf("  Stimulation: %s\n", stim))

    screening_results <- bind_rows(lapply(cytokine_cols, function(cyt) {
      screen_lme(
        data          = data_long,
        cytokine_name = cyt,
        outcome       = config$outcome,
        stimulation   = stim,
        covariates    = covariates,
        min_obs       = config$min_obs,
        min_subjects  = config$min_subjects
      )
    }))

    if (nrow(screening_results) == 0) {
      cat(sprintf("  No results for %s | %s. Skipping.\n", stim, config$outcome))
      next
    }

    cat(sprintf("  Cytokines screened: %d\n", nrow(screening_results)))

    screening_results <- screening_results %>%
      mutate(
        Visit_p_adj       = p.adjust(Visit_p,       method = "fdr"),
        Cytokine_p_adj    = p.adjust(Cytokine_p,    method = "fdr"),
        Interaction_p_adj = p.adjust(Interaction_p, method = "fdr"),
        Visit_sig         = Visit_p_adj       < 0.05,
        Cytokine_sig      = Cytokine_p_adj    < 0.05,
        Interaction_sig   = Interaction_p_adj < 0.05,
        Any_sig           = Visit_sig | Cytokine_sig | Interaction_sig
      ) %>%
      arrange(Interaction_p_adj)

    cat(sprintf(
      "  FDR-significant: Visit = %d | Cytokine = %d | Interaction = %d\n",
      sum(screening_results$Visit_sig,       na.rm = TRUE),
      sum(screening_results$Cytokine_sig,    na.rm = TRUE),
      sum(screening_results$Interaction_sig, na.rm = TRUE)
    ))

    write_xlsx(screening_results, file.path(out_dir, "LME_screening_results.xlsx"))

    cytokines_to_plot <- screening_results %>% filter(Interaction_sig)

    if (nrow(cytokines_to_plot) == 0) {
      cat("  No FDR-significant interactions. Plotting top 10 by raw p-value.\n")
      cytokines_to_plot <- head(screening_results, 10)
    }

    cat(sprintf("  Cytokines to plot: %d\n", nrow(cytokines_to_plot)))

    for (cyt in cytokines_to_plot$Cytokine) {
      plot_lme(
        data          = data_long,
        cytokine_name = cyt,
        outcome       = config$outcome,
        outcome_label = config$label,
        visit_colors  = visit_colors,
        stimulation   = stim,
        covariates    = covariates,
        save_path     = out_dir
      )
    }

    summary_table <- screening_results %>%
      select(
        Cytokine, Stimulation, N_obs, N_subjects,
        Visit_p, Visit_p_adj, Visit_sig,
        Cytokine_p, Cytokine_p_adj, Cytokine_sig,
        Interaction_p, Interaction_p_adj, Interaction_sig, Any_sig
      )

    write_xlsx(summary_table, file.path(out_dir, "LME_summary_table.xlsx"))

    all_analyses[[paste0(analysis_name, "_", stim)]] <- list(
      screening_results = screening_results,
      cytokines_plotted = cytokines_to_plot$Cytokine
    )
  }
}
```
